project: Runtime Review Hardening (WDK Runtime, Retrieval, and API Exposure)
overview: Harden runtime behavior across WDK scheduling/draining, retrieval fallback logic, citations API exposure gating, pgvector readiness checks, and ingest failure UX so runtime outcomes are deterministic, observable, and safe by default in production posture.
goals: Eliminate partial Quick Start step scheduling outcomes for a run.
Prevent cross-run inline drainer claims in development ingest paths.
Keep citations route hidden outside dev and demo-prod.
Avoid unnecessary semantic embedding work when no vectors exist.
Remove false pgvector disabled outcomes caused by concurrent setup.
Make ingest failure reasons understandable to non-technical users.
nonGoals: Re-architecting the run_steps table or worker model.
Changing question-set content or run product semantics.
Introducing new retrieval ranking algorithms or embedding model changes.
Changing ingest threshold limits or broad document processing policy.
Broad UI redesign beyond ingest error messaging.
successMetrics: Quick Start runs converge to expected step counts and complete without partial scheduling regressions.
No STEP_TYPE_UNKNOWN failures for quick_start_title_survey.write_row_v0 caused by ingest inline draining.
Citations route remains inaccessible in prod posture even when FEATURE_CITATIONS_API=1.
Retrieval reports semanticDisabledReason=NO_VECTORS and returns lexical results when vector count is zero.
Ingest failures are shown with friendly user-facing messages while retaining operator-visible technical detail.
openQuestions: Confirm final wording for user-facing ingest error copy with product/design owner.
Confirm whether embed-call avoidance is asserted via targeted unit mocking, integration coverage, or both.

No broad UI layout changes are in scope.

rules: Quick Start question-step scheduling must be atomic and idempotent.
Inline drainer claim behavior must scope by runId when runId is provided.
Inline Quick Start self-progress kick is allowed only in dev/demo-prod and must remain off in prod.
Citations API exposure must always be gated by assertDevOrDemoProdApi regardless of feature flag state.
Hybrid retrieval must skip semantic branch execution when vector count is zero and report NO_VECTORS.
Pgvector setup must be idempotent and race-safe by using IF NOT EXISTS and a catch-path existence re-check.
Ingest error codes must map to friendly primary UI copy with technical detail preserved secondarily.

stories.title: Atomic Quick Start Scheduling and Reconciliation
stories.description: As an engineer, I want Quick Start question steps to be scheduled atomically with reconciliation so that runs do not get stuck with partial step sets.
acceptanceCriteria: Example: if one step insert fails during scheduling, the transaction rolls back and no partial question-step set is committed.
Example: for a run with questions_total = N, reconciliation backfills missing steps and converges to exactly N question steps.
Negative: duplicate scheduling attempts must not create duplicate rows for the same (run_id, step_key).

stories.title: Run-Scoped Inline Draining and Dev/Demo Quick Start Self-Progress
stories.description: As a developer running demo flows, I want inline draining scoped by run id and auto-kicked Quick Start processing so that development runs progress without cross-run interference.
acceptanceCriteria: Example: ingest inline drain invoked with ingest runId only claims and handles steps for that run.
Example: in dev or demo-prod, creating a Quick Start run begins consuming steps without requiring a separate worker process.
Negative: in prod posture, inline kick remains disabled and does not process steps.
Negative: Quick Start steps are not failed as STEP_TYPE_UNKNOWN due to ingest handler mismatch.

stories.title: Citations API Re-Locked to Internal/Dev-Only Surface
stories.description: As a security-conscious operator, I want citations API exposure locked to dev and demo-prod regardless of feature toggles so that production posture stays closed by default.
acceptanceCriteria: Example: in prod posture, citations route returns a not-found style envelope even when FEATURE_CITATIONS_API=1.
Example: in dev and demo-prod, DB-first citations behavior continues to work with fixture fallback behavior.
Negative: feature flags do not bypass environment gate checks.

stories.title: Semantic Branch Short-Circuit for Zero-Vector Corpora
stories.description: As an engineer, I want retrieval to skip semantic work when nVectors is zero so that empty-vector environments avoid unnecessary embedding cost and warning noise.
acceptanceCriteria: Example: with lexical chunks present and zero vectors, retrieval returns lexical results and reports semanticDisabledReason as NO_VECTORS.
Example: when semantic is disabled, effective weighting behaves as lexical-only (lex=1, sem=0).
Negative: embedding call paths are not executed when nVectors equals zero.

stories.title: Pgvector Setup Idempotency and Race-Safe Readiness
stories.description: As an engineer, I want pgvector setup to tolerate concurrent initialization so that schema readiness does not report false disabled states.
acceptanceCriteria: Example: concurrent schema setup calls do not produce false PGVECTOR_DISABLED outcomes when extension creation succeeds in one caller.
Example: extension setup uses CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector.
Negative: environments without extension support still fail safe and preserve explicit disablement behavior.

stories.title: Friendly Ingest Failure Messaging in Matter UI
stories.description: As a non-technical user, I want readable ingest failure explanations so that I can take corrective action without parsing raw JSON errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Example: known ingest codes (INGEST_TOO_MANY_PAGES, INGEST_PAGE_TEXT_TOO_LARGE, INGEST_TOTAL_TEXT_TOO_LARGE) map to clear, actionable messages.
Example: UI shows a friendly primary message and retains technical details in secondary debug-visible text.
Negative: unknown codes fall back safely without blank states, crashes, or leaking internal-only details.

functionalRequirements: FR-001: Quick Start scheduling inserts all question steps in one transaction or none.
FR-002: Reconciliation backfills missing Quick Start steps to match questions_total.
FR-004: drainWdkStepsOnce scopes claims by runId when provided.
FR-005: startDocumentIngest passes returned runId to inline kick.
FR-006: folders runs route auto-kicks Quick Start processing only in dev/demo-prod.
FR-007: prod posture keeps inline kick disabled.
FR-008: citations route enforces assertDevOrDemoProdApi before feature-flag branches.
FR-009: hybridSearch short-circuits semantic branch when nVectors is zero.
FR-010: hybridSearch debug output includes semanticDisabledReason NO_VECTORS when applicable.
FR-011: lexical-only fallback weighting is explicit when semantic is disabled.
FR-012: retrieval schema uses CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector.
FR-013: retrieval schema catch path re-checks extension existence before returning false disabled state.
FR-014: ingest error mapper covers known codes plus a safe fallback.
FR-015: matter page renders friendly ingest error copy as primary text.
FR-016: technical error details remain available for operator debugging.
FR-017: targeted regression tests are added or updated for each workstream.
FR-018: full repository verification passes via pnpm verify.
verificationPlan: Run targeted workstream tests first, then execute pnpm verify.
Validate mixed-run queue isolation (ingest + quick-start) under inline draining.
Validate mode-gated citations behavior in dev, demo-prod, and prod postures.
Validate no-vector retrieval behavior with debug reason assertions.
Validate friendly ingest error copy plus technical-detail fallback rendering.
failureStatesAndUX: Mid-scheduling insert failure rolls back transaction and avoids partial visible state.
Cross-run claim risk is prevented by run-scoped draining where runId is supplied.
Citations calls outside allowed modes return a not-found safe envelope.
No-vector retrieval falls back lexically with NO_VECTORS reason instead of hard failure.
Pgvector unsupported environments preserve safe disablement behavior.
Ingest limit failures show friendly actionable messages with secondary technical detail.
metricsLogging: Structured reconciliation event for Quick Start backfills: wdk.quick_start.reconciled with run_id, expected_steps, existing_steps, inserted_steps, trace_id.
Inline drain logs include run_id and handler_count.
Quick Start reliability monitored via absence of persistent partial/stalled running runs.
Retrieval monitoring tracks NO_VECTORS incidence and reduced avoidable semantic embedding failures.
rollbackDisablePath: Revert workstream-specific code paths independently: scheduling transaction/reconciliation, runId scoping, citations gate placement, NO_VECTORS short-circuit, pgvector DDL/catch behavior, ingest UI message mapping.
No schema migration rollback is required for this slice.
Production remains safe by default through existing runtime-mode gating behavior.
risks: Scheduling transaction could increase latency for larger question sets.
Run-scoping behavior could be missed in edge caller paths that do not pass runId.
New semantic disabled reason values could impact strict downstream parsers.
Ingest code-to-message mapping could drift from backend error code definitions.
dependencies: Deterministic integration test scaffolding for queue and route behavior.
Correct runtime-mode configuration across dev, demo-prod, and prod environments.
Existing WDK and retrieval modules remaining stable while hardening changes are applied.
